eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Nine
subtitle: Lesson 93 · Transactions, Locking, and Isolation Levels

caption: Session A's transaction is still open -- it isn't done yet.

eyebrow: Session B -- commits a real change
code:
-- SESSION B
UPDATE Production.Product
SET ListPrice = 49.99
WHERE ProductID = 680;
-- Commits immediately (autocommit).
caption: A fully real, fully committed update -- not a dirty, in-flight value.

eyebrow: Session A -- second read, same transaction
caption: Same question, same transaction, two different answers.

code:
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ;
-- Holds a shared lock on every row read
-- until this transaction ends --
-- Session B's UPDATE would have to WAIT.
caption: Allowed under READ UNCOMMITTED/READ COMMITTED; prevented from REPEATABLE READ up.

subtitle: When the whole SET of rows changes, not just one value.
